_note: Our own notes per trail, from walking them, and name overrides where the automatic naming falls short. 'walked' entries should say when and what we found.

T-3.walked: Walked on 8 October 2026 from Velestovo past Gorni Studenec spring to about 1,420 m. Our GPS track sits a median 2 m from this line. The spring is a pipe and a trough. Below it the path is stony; above it the marked path climbs through leafy beech forest on soft ground, steep in spots, and is much nicer walking.

G-6.loop_note: G-6 climbs from the pass through beech forest, then loops over Magaro (2,254 m) and back down to the same path, so the GPX has two pieces: the approach and the loop.
